D/ IMP NERVA CAES AVG PM TRP COS III PP ; R/ FORTUNA AVGVSTI

A sliver denarius of Nerva, Reece period: 5 [96-117], Obverse description: Laureate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP NERVA CAES AVG PM TRP COS III PP. Reverse description: Fortuna with a rudder and a cornucopia. Reverse inscription: FORTUNA AVGVSTI
